description: RECIBOS DE INFRAESTRUCTURA DE ALUMBRADO PÚBLICO is a series of datasets listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. Infraestructura recibida por la UAESP para administrar, operar y mantener. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Servicios Públicos - UAESP. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2023-08-31 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
